answers.core: It makes no sense for it to not be exposed considering it's already part of the codebase.
answers.workaround: Right now, some addons exist to emulate accordion menus, but considering godot has a native one in its codebase that's just not exposed to other elements than the editor, it would be way more efficient to just expose it.

title: Make EditorInspectorSection a general usable UI control
